history.overview: The Pool of Sludge was once part of the Dragorn purification system, later corrupted by Discord and Muramite waste.

timeline.name: Purification Era
timeline.description: Dragorn engineers used the pool to filter water for the undercity.

timeline.name: Muramite Dumping
timeline.description: Muramite handlers dumped failed experiments and waste into the pool.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord energy warped the sludge into toxic, living horrors.

timeline.name: Resistance Recon
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels scouted the pool but found it too dangerous to infiltrate.
